title: Matterbridge Tado plugin
description: Tado (thermostats connectés, vannes, détecteurs). On first start, watch the Matterbridge logs for the pairing code and URL to authorize this plugin with your Tado account (OAuth2 Device Code Flow).

homeId.title: Home Id
homeId.description: Tado home id to expose. Leave 0 to auto-select your first home.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to refresh zone state from the Tado API. Minimum and recommended 60s to respect Tado rate limits.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the zones in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the zones will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The zones in the list will not be exposed. If the list is empty, no zones will be excluded.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin. Only for debugging purposes, not recommended for production use.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging purposes, not recommended for production use.
